_note: Wren Phonics (b406c, 2026-10-07) — hand-checked ARPAbet pronunciations for words soundCheck() needs that are missing from, or wrong for OUR purposes in, cmudict.dict (an entry here always wins over cmudict.dict). Keys under 'words' are lowercase; values are arrays of pronunciations (each a space-separated ARPAbet phone string, stress digits optional since soundCheck ignores stress). Keep this list small — most words should come from the CMU dictionary itself. 'a': cmudict only has the natural-speech reductions (schwa AH0, or the name-sound EY1 for emphasis) — Reception Phase 2 deliberately teaches the article 'a' sounded out as /a/ (AE), same convention as Little Wandle and every other English SSP, so this overrides cmudict's real-speech entries with the taught one. 'bleat'/'mends'/'squawked': absent from cmudict.dict entirely; plain phonetic spellings. 'hear': cmudict has HH IY1 R, inconsistent with its own entries for 'year'/'dear'/'near'/'fear'/'gear'/'deer' (all IH1 R — 'hear' is spelled with 'ear' like those, and is a true homophone of 'here', so should match them) — corrected. (NOT listed here: 'deer'/'cheer'/'reindeer' — those are cmudict's real IH1 R, matching 'year' etc.; they needed validate-decodable.js's 'ee' pattern to also allow IH, not a dictionary correction, since 'ee' immediately before 'r' is always this near-merger vowel, never plain /iː/.) 'herbs': cmudict's singular 'herb' has both a silent-h (American) and an audible-h (British, HH ER1 B) entry, but its ONLY entry for the plural 'herbs' is the silent-h one — filled in the same audible-h variant for the plural. 'roundest'/'barer': absent from cmudict.dict (too rare to be listed); regular root+suffix pronunciations.
